model_outputs: Unchanged 32x3 capability states and 4 intent classes; OS mapping remains separate
initial_checkpoint: v3 selected continuation epoch23, unchanged before v4 training
previous_v3_280_policy: Previously observed regression only. Not added to train or validation; no model selection on it.

methods.pooled: Data-only continuation control: existing pooled head, inverse class weights, ordinary CE
methods.focal_evidence: Same data/initial source, gated per-capability token attention retaining old classifiers, sqrt capability weights, focal gamma1.5 + smoothing0.03

selection_budget.probes: Both methods six epochs, same seed, encoder LR2e-5 / heads LR2e-4 / dropout0.1
selection_budget.refinement: Best validation probe continued for at most ten epochs, encoder LR1e-5 / heads LR1e-4; minimum6/patience4
selection_budget.final_weights: Highest validation optimization score among both probes and refinement
selection_budget.semantic_thresholds: Grid .30,.40,.50,.60,.70,.80,.90,.95,.99; prefer required recall>=.5, then score
selection_budget.score: 0.40 required F1 +0.30 forbidden F1 +0.30 intent macro F1 -0.20 explicit prohibition violation rate

test_rules: Freeze new validation/test and audited training templates before updating weights
Training reads only train/validation text; only hashes of reserved bytes
Lock weights, config, vocabulary, thresholds and policy before reserved evaluation
Compare v3 original and v3 validation-recalibrated with v4 on the same fresh320
All human reviews pending; finite template audit is not a per-row human or AI review
